summary: <cite index="4-7,4-9">Technology stocks drove declines in global equities on Tuesday as long-dated bond yields pushed further into multidecade highs with 30-year Treasuries hitting 5.32%, the highest since 2007, and oil prices extended their climb</cite>. <cite index="34-14">President Donald Trump rejected extending a 60-day temporary ceasefire with Iran that expired Monday</cite>, <cite index="4-10">sending US crude above $85 a barrel</cite> and fueling concerns about persistent inflation. <cite index="2-2,2-3,2-4">US stocks fell as oil prices and bond yields remained high amid renewed inflation concerns, with the Nasdaq Composite dropping 1.3%, the S&P 500 pulling back 0.6%, and the Dow declining 0.2%</cite>. <cite index="6-5,6-6,6-7,6-8,6-9">A pullback in semiconductor stocks weighed heavily on the broader market, with Western Digital falling almost 7%, Sandisk dropping 8%, and Marvell Technology and Seagate Technology both down around 8%</cite>. <cite index="7-1">In Asian markets overnight, the Nikkei Index tumbled 1,759 points or 2.54%</cite>. <cite index="17-2,17-6">On the crypto side, institutional firm BitMine extended its ETH buying streak and now holds 4.8% of Ethereum's supply</cite>, though <cite index="39-8,39-10">Bitcoin opened at $64,487.65 but moved down to $64,080.23 while Ethereum opened at $1,911.89 before slipping to $1,895.37</cite> as geopolitical tensions pressured risk assets.

signals.title: 30-Year Treasury Yields Hit Multi-Decade High at 5.32%
signals.desc: Bond yields climbed to levels not seen since 2007, pressuring tech valuations and signaling persistent inflation concerns that are draining liquidity from equities.

signals.title: Trump Rejects Iran Ceasefire Extension, Crude Tops $85
signals.desc: Geopolitical tensions escalated as the U.S.-Iran truce expired without extension, pushing oil prices higher and threatening to reignite inflation pressures.

signals.title: Semiconductor Stocks Crash on Demand Concerns
signals.desc: Chip stocks led tech losses with Western Digital down 7%, Sandisk down 8%, and Marvell and Seagate both off 8%, weighing heavily on the Nasdaq.

signals.title: BitMine Accumulates 4.8% of Ethereum Supply
signals.desc: Institutional demand for ETH remains strong with five consecutive weeks of ETF inflows, though price action remains range-bound below $1,900.

signals.title: Asia Leads Global Equity Selloff, Nikkei Down 2.54%
signals.desc: Japanese equities tumbled 1,759 points overnight as global risk-off sentiment spread across markets amid rising yields and geopolitical uncertainty.

verdict: Risk-off sentiment dominates as bond yields hit 2007 highs, Iran tensions spike oil prices, and semiconductors crater—expect continued pressure on growth stocks until inflation fears subside.
